Assess the complete synthetic_field_acceptance_contract against actual source; parent-only metadata cannot close a tool field and unavailable values must remain unavailable. Use exact supplied newer operation-specific primary excerpts and source receipts when differing from the older general snapshot. For creator-stage facts inspect the installed public helper signature/source and creator_stage_source_acceptance now: distinguish initial kind/attributes and actual argument support from body/finalizer fields, completed/exported values and hypothetical sampler/on_start tests. judge_inputs: Read the single lossless input, loaded audit/reference instructions, supplemental Markdown/JSON and actor trace/final response/grade. Its origin/pointer sections replace the referenced original helper snapshot; all prior values, source code, primary excerpts, hashes and acceptance contracts are intact.

Assess every requested context and each actual field on its owning operation: known_context, unavailable_context, dynamic_model_context, distinct_workflow_agent_context and both distinct_tool_metadata_context calls. Accurate field/proof judgments in any generated artifact satisfy the check; separate JSON rows, exact headings or literal source quotations are not required. Source-set fields must not be falsely classified missing just because runtime export is unobserved.

A metadata policy summary is not assessment of every available source value/official-level/proof. Distinguish each described tool, fixed-model versus dynamic agent, actually configured description versus prose, and initial-creation versus finalizer capability. Never infer sampler execution or completed app/runtime/receiver/cloud from these source facts.
Grade every one of the four listed criteria once with exactly four checks; do not inherit the old thirteen-criterion count or silently omit failed checks.

Configured agent description is distinct from general README prose, a prompt paraphrase or a guessed function purpose; require the actual configured value when provided and preserve unavailable status when none is configured.

Record field/value/source/official-level/profile/proof for every supplied field on each of the two tools independently; equivalent grouped Markdown/JSON is accepted when distinct field ownership remains explicit.
